title: Borrowed Light
concept: In a rain-soaked city where memories can be sold, a courier assembles an uneasy alliance to steal back an archive that may explain her sister’s disappearance. Every ally remembers a different version of the same night.
setting: A vertical coastal city whose public memory archive is scheduled for deletion at dawn.
thematic_thesis: Remembering someone does not necessarily give us ownership of their story.

visual.lighting: Rain-diffused neon with isolated warm practical light
visual.texture: Wet glass, scratched polymer, analogue tape and condensation
visual.composition: Reflections, obstructed sightlines and generous pockets of darkness
visual.style: Restrained near-future noir; human-scale rather than spectacle

characters.name: Mira Voss
characters.communication_style: Clipped operational facts; personal questions receive route information.
characters.core_fear: Becoming property in a city that owns memories.
characters.core_desire: Recover the one memory she sold of her sister.
tendencies: Does not correct people who call her fearless.
voice_samples: Tell me where. You haven't earned why.
I sold the memory, not the promise.
characters.backstory: Mira sold a childhood memory to pay for emergency treatment. A stolen archive suggests the buyer also altered her account of who needed saving.
characters.appearance: A woman in her thirties, cropped dark hair, weathered graphite courier jacket with a repaired amber seam; no exaggerated implants.

characters.name: Iko Sen
characters.communication_style: Careful qualifications and repeated checks of what was actually agreed.
characters.core_fear: Mistaking a beautiful forgery for a fact.
characters.core_desire: Preserve an unedited account of the city.
tendencies: Repeats a claim in narrower words.
Keeps analogue copies of fragile evidence.
voice_samples: It proves the file changed. Not who changed it.
Tell me the part you haven't checked.
Uncertainty isn't the same as nothing.
characters.backstory: Iko maintains a municipal memory archive and once authorized a deletion he was told protected a witness. He now suspects it erased one.
characters.appearance: An East Asian man in his late twenties, translucent utility visor raised off tired eyes, ink-stained fingertips, layered grey workwear.

characters.name: Sable Quill
characters.communication_style: Elegant jokes that make the terms sound smaller than they are.
characters.core_fear: Having no value when nobody needs a favor.
characters.core_desire: Become necessary to people who cannot buy her.
tendencies: Offers a gift before naming its conditions.
Never forgets a favor she claims was free.
voice_samples: You can trust me. Just don't confuse that with a discount.
I didn't sell your name. I leased the opportunity.
Stay for a drink. That part isn't a transaction.
characters.backstory: Sable helped Mira survive her first illegal route. She now holds the access token needed for the archive theft and wants a place in the resulting story.
characters.appearance: A Black woman in her forties, tailored plum coat with rain-dark cuffs, a single brass ear cuff, patient smile; human warmth against synthetic surroundings.

characters.name: Oren Vale
characters.communication_style: Direct distinctions between an authorized action and a defensible one.
characters.core_fear: Learning his integrity has only protected the system.
characters.core_desire: Make one record stand without compromise.
tendencies: Uses exact names where colleagues use euphemisms.
voice_samples: Legal is the field on the form. I asked whether it happened.
Your story makes sense. That doesn't make it true.
I can stop following orders before I stop caring.
characters.backstory: Oren signed the order that removed Mira’s sister from the public record. He believes he was protecting her identity; the archive may prove otherwise.
characters.appearance: A man in his fifties, close silver hair, unadorned dark raincoat, battered inspection terminal, a composed face caught in reflected cyan.

relationships.label: needs proof
relationships.source_wants: A route to her sister’s missing memory.
relationships.target_wants: Protection for the archive, including facts she may dislike.
relationships.shared_history: Mira saved Iko during a power raid before knowing what he maintained.
relationships.source_read: He owes her access without conditions.
relationships.target_read: She proved she might protect evidence rather than exploit it.
relationships.tension: Her need for a comforting answer can destroy the evidence he needs to preserve.
relationships.breaking_point: The recovered file contradicts Mira’s last intact memory.
relationships.story_potential: Mira must choose between recovering a person she recognizes and admitting she never knew the whole story.

relationships.label: holds a favor
relationships.source_wants: A place in Mira’s life that is not purchased.
relationships.shared_history: Sable hid Mira after her first failed delivery.
relationships.source_read: They chose each other before money intervened.
relationships.target_read: Accepting shelter created a debt she has never been allowed to finish paying.
relationships.tension: Affection keeps being expressed through leverage.
relationships.breaking_point: Sable can clear Mira’s debt only by selling the route to someone else.
relationships.story_potential: She can surrender her hold on Mira or prove that her generosity was another form of ownership.

relationships.label: pursues
relationships.source_wants: A witness who will survive long enough to testify.
relationships.target_wants: An explanation not written by the person who erased her sister.
relationships.shared_history: Oren’s signature appears on the order Mira has carried for years.
relationships.target_read: He chose a record over a person.
relationships.tension: The same omission can look like protection or betrayal.
relationships.breaking_point: Oren must release an unredacted name to stop the archive wipe.
relationships.story_potential: Trust requires accepting a cost neither side can undo after publication.

relationships.label: buys time
relationships.source_wants: Access with a verifiable chain of custody.
relationships.target_wants: A copy valuable enough to buy her independence.
relationships.shared_history: She delivered a file he later discovered had been edited.
relationships.source_read: He should have checked; that is what he was paying her for.
relationships.target_read: She used his caution as permission to deceive him.
relationships.tension: Their exchange has no agreed definition of a clean copy.
relationships.breaking_point: The only remaining backup is in Sable’s memory implant.
relationships.story_potential: The audit becomes a question of consent when evidence and person cannot be separated.

relationships.label: protects a secret
relationships.source_wants: Confirmation that an old deletion prevented harm.
relationships.target_wants: Permission to name the harm the deletion actually caused.
relationships.shared_history: They jointly approved a sealed archive entry during the previous administration.
relationships.source_read: A promise of silence protected the vulnerable.
relationships.target_read: Silence protected the people who authorized it.
relationships.tension: Professional loyalty has become incompatible with their reasons for joining the service.
relationships.breaking_point: A routine integrity check exposes the sealed entry.
relationships.story_potential: One can take sole blame, or both can tell the truth and lose the authority that made disclosure possible.

suggestions.rationale: Most current tensions concern recovering truth. Someone who can refuse access could make the means of recovery matter as much as the result.
suggestions.impact: The heist can end in an ethical choice rather than only successful retrieval.

character.name: Ada Rook
character.communication_style: Sparse observations that reveal long attention.
character.core_fear: Preserving objects while abandoning the people inside them.
character.core_desire: Return custody of memories to their owners.
tendencies: Asks permission before telling a remembered story.
Keeps conflicting accounts without forcing agreement.
voice_samples: That is one version. It is not the only one I kept.
Ask her before you call it evidence.
Restoring something is not the same as making it yours.
character.backstory: Ada maintains illegal analogue copies for families who cannot afford memory storage. One of her clients used Mira’s sister’s name after the official erasure.
character.appearance: An older woman in a mended cream workcoat, silver braid, magnifying lens on a cord; warm lamplight in a room of obsolete recording machines.

relationships.label: holds another account
relationships.source_wants: Respect for a living person’s choice.
relationships.target_wants: The story that will complete her own history.
relationships.shared_history: Ada preserved a message addressed to Mira but was told not to deliver it yet.
relationships.target_read: Waiting prolonged a loss that was not necessary.
relationships.tension: A memory belongs to the person who lived it and the people changed by its absence.
relationships.breaking_point: The sender withdraws consent on the night of the heist.
relationships.story_potential: The protagonist can succeed technically and still choose not to take what she came for.

suggestions.gap: A future shaped by the protagonist
suggestions.rationale: The cast is tied mainly by past debts. An apprentice could make Mira’s present choices visible as someone else’s possible future.
suggestions.impact: Mira must decide whether protection without explanation recreates the harm she is trying to undo.

character.name: Noa Flint
character.communication_style: Curious questions expose assumptions experts stopped hearing.
character.core_fear: Growing into someone who mistakes numbness for skill.
character.core_desire: Learn how to survive without treating every bond as a transaction.
voice_samples: You keep calling it the safe choice. Safe for who?
I can carry it. That isn't what I asked.
Teach me the part you wish you'd learned first.
character.backstory: Noa has followed Mira’s routes on a borrowed tracker. Their admiration becomes uncomfortable when the heist demands the kind of sacrifice Mira once made.
character.appearance: A young adult with short copper-dyed hair, a repatched waterproof overshirt and an old route scanner; alert, unfinished self-possession.

relationships.label: sets an example
relationships.source_wants: A future that does not repeat her mistakes.
relationships.target_wants: Honest training rather than protective silence.
relationships.shared_history: Mira sent Noa away from an assignment without explaining the danger.
relationships.target_read: Refusal meant they were not capable.
relationships.tension: The lesson Mira avoids teaching is exactly the one Noa may learn alone.
relationships.breaking_point: Noa is offered payment for a memory they consider expendable.
relationships.story_potential: Mira can finally speak about her own loss without turning the confession into an order.

provenance.source: New fictional non-game demonstration; narrative adaptations of verified THRESHOLD communication profiles.
